summary: Build agency banking strategy, risk, liquidity, and agent network skills through practical exercises. Enrol in the five-day course.
lede: Agency banking enables financial institutions to deliver defined services through third-party agents. This training is for agency banking managers, digital finance specialists, risk officers, and partnership leads who plan or improve agent networks. Learn to assess agent coverage and segmentation, calculate agent economics and liquidity needs, and develop risk controls and performance dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for expanding, governing, analysing, or supporting agency banking channels across regulated financial services and digital finance environments.
modules: Agency Banking Models and Market Strategy
Risk, AML, and Customer Protection Controls
Agency Banking Roadmaps and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to banking operations, payments, digital financial services, agency networks, compliance, or financial distribution. No programming is required. Basic spreadsheet skills are useful for the liquidity, economics, and KPI exercises. Advanced technology topics such as AI-assisted monitoring and interoperability are taught at operational application and conceptual awareness levels, not production engineering level.
